body.title: fix(cache): type the `withCacheIsolation` result as a promise
body.body:
Resolves #1670

`withCacheIsolation` was typed to return `T`, but the wrapper is async, so a synchronous handler's result came back as a Promise while the type said otherwise.

The returned handler is now typed as `(event: H3Event) => Promise<Awaited<ReturnType<T>>>`, and keeps the properties of the wrapped handler (such as ocache's `invalidate`) through `Pick<T, keyof T>`. No runtime change.

Added type tests for a sync and an async handler and for a copied property. `pnpm typecheck`, the type tests, the cache and route rules tests, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm build` pass.

body.title: fix(types): emit declarations that typecheck with skipLibCheck: false
body.body:
Fixes #1657

### Summary

Downstream TypeScript projects importing `h3` with `skipLibCheck: false` failed `tsc --noEmit` unless they targeted `ESNext` and installed the optional peer dependency `crossws`:

1. `dist/h3.d.mts` emitted `static override isError` on `HTTPError`. Because `Error.isError` only exists in the `ESNext` lib, consumers targeting `ES2022` (or any pre-`ESNext` lib) got `TS4113`.
2. `dist/index.d.mts` imported `Hooks`, `Peer`, and `Message` from the optional peer `crossws`, producing `TS2307` when `crossws` is not installed.

### Changes

- Updated `build.config.ts` (`hooks.end`) to post-process emitted `dist/**/*.d.mts`:
  - Strip `override` from `static override isError` in published declarations while keeping `static override isError` in `src/error.ts` so this repo's own `noImplicitOverride` + `ESNext` typecheck continues to pass (`override` on `name` and `cause` stays intact because both exist in `ES2022`).
  - Prepend `// @ts-ignore optional peer dependency` above the `from "crossws"` import in `dist/index.d.mts`, suppressing `TS2307` when `crossws` is absent while preserving exact nominal types (`Peer`, `Message`, `Hooks`) when `crossws` is installed.
- Added a real `tsc --noEmit` consumer regression suite in `test/dts-consumer.test.ts` testing `skipLibCheck: false` + `noImplicitOverride: true` across `ES2022` and `ESNext`, both with and without `crossws` installed (and asserting nominal equality when `crossws` is present).

### Verification

- **Red before fix:** `pnpm exec vitest --run test/dts-consumer.test.ts` reproduced both `TS4113` (`h3.d.mts`) and `TS2307` (`index.d.mts`) on `ES2022` without `crossws`.
- **Green after fix:**
  - `pnpm build`
  - `pnpm lint` (`oxlint` + `oxfmt --check`)
  - `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`)
  - `pnpm exec vitest --run test/dts-consumer.test.ts` — 4/4 passed.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved TypeScript compatibility for package declarations in downstream projects using ES2022 or ESNext, including setups with or without optional WebSocket support.
  * Corrected declaration compatibility for `HTTPError.isError`, helping consumers compile with strict library checking enabled.
  * These updates make it easier to use the package’s public types across different TypeScript configurations and optional dependency setups.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
